Refer to the recorded poll totals.', optionObservations: [], participationNotes: [], quorumAssessment: 'NOT_ASSESSED', recommendedGovernanceFollowUp: ['Have an authorized committee member review the official poll result.'] }; return [{ json: { status: 'success', pollId: source.pollId, question: source.question, totalVotes: source.totalVotes, summarizedAt: new Date().toISOString(), summary } }];
